product.title: Startup Tycoon: Data-Driven Decisions
product.summary: Seven data-reasoning rounds under one startup scoreboard.
product.whatStudentsDo: Students work through seven linked exercises — pricing risky deals by expected value, giving forecast ranges, avoiding an overfitted curve, updating on new evidence, combining models, choosing under ambiguity, and calibrating their own confidence — with one running score and a closing list of what they practised.
